answer: An answer must include the first 9 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the copper derivation is checked against the oasis nonce, the nadir audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 134 aliases produces 134 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
